rule.rule: smallest k in 3..windowYears whose backtest MAE of the median forecast is within tolerance of the k=windowYears MAE
rule.backtestSeries: native MODIS cell-month counts per domain, 2000-2025

selection.series: native MODIS domain-month counts; the same rule is applied to the harmonized series because the harmonized series is a fixed multiple of VIIRS and a shorter VIIRS record only reduces the usable years
